updates.title_zh: Coinbase Seeks CFTC Approval for US Single-Stock Perpetual Futures
updates.title_en: Coinbase Seeks CFTC Approval for US Single-Stock Perpetual Futures
updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase 已向 CFTC 提交申请，拟提供美国单只股票永续期货，该产品将在 Coinbase Derivatives 上 24/5 交易，采用每小时资金费率，并通过 Nodal Clear 清算，目前申请仍待监管批准。
updates.what_changed_en: Coinbase has filed with the CFTC to offer US single-stock perpetual futures that would trade 24/5 on Coinbase Derivatives with hourly funding and Nodal Clear clearing, pending regulatory approval.
